name: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd.
blurb: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the research, development, and manufacturing of optical communication components and modules. The company focuses on high-speed optical transceivers, optical amplifiers, and passive optical components for data centers, telecom networks, and 5G infrastructure. It competes in the rapidly growing optical communications market, serving both domestic and international customers.

The stock price has moved in line with the SSE Star Market index, reflecting investor sentiment toward the optical communication sector.
